content: Current-state only. No schema migrations, no legacy DB compatibility, no old binary aliases. Update the current schema directly and rebuild from clean DB.
Entrypoints at src/<module>/main.ts. Helpers in the same directory. kebab-case filenames. Strict relative imports only.

fleet-light and fleet-heavy are provider-agnostic worker names. Do not tie them to specific model names (e.g. Gemma E2B/E4B). The underlying model can be swapped via FLEET_LIGHT_MODEL and FLEET_HEAVY_MODEL env vars.
